Makes you wonder—where is all that money going?</blockquote>Hermes is a character and [[Companions|companion]] that can be found in game, first seen in Drasilgard then later in the Commercium. He is a male dryason with dark brown to black hair and large animal ears. He wears a green cloak, a monocle, and carries a staff called the Mana Crystal Scepter. He is well mannered, though Akane says in her dialogue that she finds him suspicious.
